role: Bounded analyst authored source adoption; no runtime or complete-family claim

groups.clause_append: Record time/note/loop selection separately; occupied-generator treatment and combined-selection precedence stay U.
groups.action: On reset copies independently try a time selection, a note selection, and no selection with a declared loop. Separately record simultaneous selections without choosing precedence. Generate into an initially empty admitted time span, first observing actual NONEMPTY output; only then compare occupied overlap/nonoverlap and Rhythm deselection/layering histories. Retain the conflicting source statements as C1, not a replacement/merge law.

groups.clause_append: Apply has literal Ctrl+Enter Windows / Cmd+Enter macOS entries; the documented initially enabled state does not establish an arbitrary saved/default history.
groups.action: First produce a genuine change with the actual Apply button on a valid transformed-note target, then reset original notes/settings. With Auto Apply explicitly off, change an admitted parameter and separately invoke literal Ctrl+Enter Windows or Cmd+Enter macOS for the current tool. Contrast explicit on/off/reset histories. Initial or restored preference state is recorded, never assumed from a fresh-looking panel.
groups.documentary_expected: The actual Apply button and literal platform shortcut apply the current tool in the explicitly admitted context.
groups.documentary_comparator: Named offered controls and categorical state only; no numerical, signal, file, timing or arbitrary availability oracle.

groups.clause_append: Reset is grayed out/disabled after selected-tool defaults are restored; its parameter-only scope is distinct from note Undo/Redo.
groups.action: Change selected-tool parameters and genuinely apply a productive note transformation. Use Undo then Redo while recording note data and parameters separately. Reset actual selected-tool parameters, inspect disabled/gray Reset, then change a parameter again. Reset notes from the independent original, not by assuming Reset undoes the transformation. Exact default values and transaction grouping remain U.
groups.documentary_expected: Reset affects selected-tool parameters and is disabled/gray after restoration; note Undo/Redo remains separate.
groups.documentary_comparator: Named offered controls and categorical state only; no numerical, signal, file, timing or arbitrary availability oracle.

groups.clause_append: Use the Browser MIDI Tools group or MIDI Tool Content tag. Bundled Velocity Shaper/Euclidean Standard/Suite availability is distinct from Suite or Standard plus Max for Live add-on prerequisites for editing/building tools and third-party tools.
groups.action: In independently admitted Standard and Suite contexts inspect the bundled Velocity Shaper and Euclidean entries via Browser MIDI Tools group or MIDI Tool Content tag; actually select an admitted entry. Separately declare Suite or Standard plus Max for Live add-on before any owned-tool editing/building/third-party probe. Reuse Max host Edit/Save/folder cases and Browser filter roles; do not infer built-in editability from a Max entry or arbitrary missing-tool availability. On a productive pitch tool compare independently accepted scale on/off control units, without deriving a pitch formula.
groups.documentary_expected: Named Browser tool selection and bundled availability roles are distinct from independently qualified Max editing/building/third-party roles.
groups.documentary_comparator: Named offered controls and categorical state only; no numerical, signal, file, timing or arbitrary availability oracle.

groups.clause_append: Expose Style chooser, Distance, Steps, Rate and Gate as separate controls; scale state qualifies Distance units.
groups.action: On a reset nonempty chord first obtain a productive arpeggiation. Actually choose offered Style entries, then change independently admitted Distance, Steps, Rate and Gate separately; contrast scale explicitly off/on for Distance. Record the selected controls and resulting nonempty sequence without asserting style algorithms, random streams, transposition formula, clipping or gate rounding.

groups.clause_append: Positive Gaps replaces a pattern-note position after that many notes; it does not assert timeline insertion. Emphasis toggles qualify Stretch Chunks and gray corresponding pattern positions; Variation is a separate control.
groups.action: Start with a genuine productive Chop, then on independent resets set Parts above 16, signed Gaps +2 and -2, and inspect the repeating pattern. Toggle a manual gap and record dash, then actually change Gaps to replace that manual pattern. Enable emphasis, change Stretch Chunks and inspect corresponding gray positions. Change Variation and apply repeatedly without requiring a different realization. Preserve the original 2..64 and manual-gap case; pattern-note replacement supplies no timeline-duration insertion law.

groups.clause_append: Spread, Density, Rate and Tie are independently settable controls on a productive gap-insertion target.
groups.action: First demonstrate actual inserted notes between independently identifiable original notes. On exact resets set nonzero Spread, an admitted intermediate Density, and distinct Rate and Tie settings; actually Apply each. Inspect generated note data relative to original bounds without inventing distributions, pairing, endpoint equality or exact counts. An empty or failed insertion is U before any absence/bounds assertion.

groups.clause_append: Start/Curve can be edited directly or by dragging the tool display yellow breakpoint horizontally and connecting line vertically. These tool-display gestures are distinct from generic MPE lane editing; C3 remains U.
groups.action: Use at least two successive notes and first obtain an actual pitch-bend result. Reset independently, edit Start and Curve directly; then drag the Glissando tool display yellow breakpoint horizontally and connecting line vertically. Record actual control changes. Reuse current MPE mode/lane actions for inspecting expression, without treating generic lane points as this tool display. Record Notes, folded-note and optional Pitch Bend lane contexts separately; do not settle C3, range mapping or curve interpolation.

groups.clause_append: Offer separate expression targets, shape/Shape/Reseed, Rate/Time Shift, Amount/Base and Attack/Decay controls. Display/optional-lane claims retain C3.
groups.action: On independent nonempty note resets first obtain actual nonzero expression from an accepted target. Select Pitch Bend, Slide and Pressure separately; operate Sine/Square/Triangle/Random, Shape, Random Reseed, Rate, signed Time Shift, Amount, Base and Attack/Decay. Retain the genuine Attack-100 reset branch from the old case. Inspect Notes/MPE/fold/optional-lane contexts without resolving C3. Do not require a new random realization or grade waveform samples, phase, bend conversion, numeric bounds or scheduling.

groups.clause_append: Flam and Grace Notes have separate toggles and Position/Velocity controls; Grace additionally exposes pitch mode, Chance and Amount.
groups.action: On separate reset originals establish genuinely productive Flam and Grace operations before comparing toggles/no-effect. Apply each repeatedly, use positive/negative Position in a declared grid with note length chosen independently, and change Velocity. For Grace choose alternating up/down and Same pitch modes, Chance and Amount separately. Record actual note additions without new count, fractional-grid, random, clipping or cross-boundary arithmetic; preserve the old Flam-only endpoint example.

groups.clause_append: The tool accepts Current Grid or a specific meter including triplets, start/end/both targets, and Edit > Quantize Settings opens its panel; C2 shortcut context remains U.
groups.action: First produce actual quantization on independently offset notes. On resets select Current Grid and an offered explicit meter/triplet setting, then start, end and both targets with admitted Amount. Invoke Edit > Quantize Settings and inspect the tool panel. Separately retain the source CtrlShiftU apply-without-opening claim as context, without equating the conflicting settings shortcut (C2) or deriving nearest-line, tie, rounding, minimum-duration or audio-Warp laws.

groups.clause_append: Rotate supports value dragging and step buttons, signed directions and Rotate on Grid; each Position/Pitch/Duration/Velocity column has its own controls.
groups.action: Retain the productive old Mirror operation. On reset distinguishable notes, operate Position, Pitch, Duration and Velocity columns separately. Change Rotate to an independently admitted nonzero value by drag and step buttons in both directions, then toggle Rotate on Grid. Combine Shuffle/Mirror/Rotate in source-described order and reapply Shuffle without requiring difference. Record actual admitted controls and productive permutation, not exact ordering of coincident notes or a rotation formula.

groups.clause_append: Offset/Variation and Apply are actual controls in all three Span modes, with final-note time-selection versus loop context explicit.
groups.action: Retain all three genuine old Legato/Tenuto/Staccato branches. From reset nonempty successive notes apply each mode, then actual signed nonzero Offset and Variation separately. Contrast a declared time selection with no time selection and a known loop for the final note. Reapply Variation without requiring difference. Productive length change precedes no-effect comparisons; no degenerate minimum, loop-boundary equality, randomness or new length equation is graded.

groups.clause_append: At least one nonzero Low/High value is required for a productive Strum comparison. Direct values and display breakpoints can edit Low/High/Tension.
groups.action: The historical MED-036 zero-only trial remains unchanged and was not a productive baseline. On a fresh identifiable chord, actually set an admitted NONZERO Low or High and apply until a genuine start-offset effect is observed. Reset original notes, repeat this productive history, then set both Low and High to zero and apply; contrast admitted Tension values only after a productive offset. Separately drag the tool display breakpoints and type signed values. If the nonzero baseline fails, zero/no-effect stays U; no nonlinear formula or numeric offset is graded.

groups.clause_append: Breakpoint enable toggles and display drags edit Time/Speed, with selected-breakpoint feedback; Quantize, Preserve Time Range and Include Note End are separate controls.
groups.action: First obtain a genuinely nonidentity tool result on identifiable notes in a declared time span. On independent originals toggle one, two and three speed breakpoints, drag enabled points and inspect selected Time/Speed feedback. Operate Quantize, Preserve Time Range and Include Note End separately, with explicit grid. Record actual controls and note data without integrating a speed curve, assuming audio Warp equivalence or grading duration/boundary formulas.

groups.clause_append: Envelope points can be added/dragged; Loop is independently settable, distinct from Rotate/Division.
groups.action: Require independently admitted Max tool capability and nonempty notes. First produce actual velocity variation, then on resets add and drag envelope points, edit Loop and repeat. Retain the old admitted minimum/maximum and Rotate=1 at Grid history, but add no new numeric envelope sampling or rotation oracle. Compare productive controls before any flat/no-effect trial; editor-data inspection needs no hardware.

groups.clause_append: Pitch/pad and Alt/Option piano entry, signed Shift, Split and Accent controls complement Steps/Pattern/Duration; layering after deselection remains C1 context.
groups.action: An initially empty generator target is allowed. Actually generate NONEMPTY rhythm notes before testing population, repetition, accent or absence. On reset targets use pitch/pad and Alt/Option piano entry; change Steps, Pattern and Duration with the documented availability dependency, signed Shift, Split and Velocity/Accent/Frequency/Offset controls. Retain the old one-versus-two repetition example. Separately deselect and add a different pitch, recording C1 without a merge law. A nonzero Density flag alone is not productive output.

groups.clause_append: Pitch/duration/velocity ranges have handles; pitch handles merge to a single pitch and can separate by click/different Min/Max. Alt/Option piano entry is explicit.
groups.action: Allow an empty initial generator target, but actually observe NONEMPTY generated notes before every range/capacity/absence comparison. On resets merge and separate pitch handles by click or independently admitted Min/Max, then use Alt/Option piano click/drag. Drag duration/velocity range handles separately and change Voices and Density. Record admitted scale on/off context. Density flags alone do not prove population; do not infer distributions, seed reproducibility, clamping or exact density-to-count.

groups.clause_append: Shape presets/drawing, Alt/Option range entry, Rate/Tie/Density and Jitter are explicit controls.
groups.action: Allow empty initial targets. Choose a Shape preset and actually draw a custom shape on separate resets; use Alt/Option piano range entry and change Rate, Tie and Density. Require actual NONEMPTY output before assessing bounds or comparing Jitter=0 and admitted nonzero Jitter. Record the output without requiring any pitch to differ between random realizations or grading shape sampling, pitch rounding, length or probability.

groups.clause_append: Chord pad click/drag and Ctrl/Cmd Up/Down select chords with Status Bar feedback. Root/piano/arrows, Add/Delete Chord and selected-chord settings are explicit; owned .stacks entry uses Places double-click and Stacks tag context.
groups.action: Use an independently valid owned recognized .stacks bank with a known productive load and chord output before comparing load/absence. Allow empty generator targets, but establish NONEMPTY chord output before range/origin claims. Click/drag the chord pad and Ctrl/Cmd Up/Down, inspect hover Status Bar text, use Root plus Alt/Option piano and arrow entry, then inversion/duration/offset on the explicitly selected chord. Actually Add and Delete Chord. In separate reset bank contexts double-click the owned bank in Places and inspect Stacks tag under the source MIDI Tool filter-group wording or MIDI Tool Content tag. Do not infer JSON grammar, arbitrary bank acceptance, Tonnetz pixels or linked instructions.

groups.clause_append: Pattern and Voices tabs expose per-voice enable/rotation/randomize, pitch/velocity and all-pitch arrows; Steps/Density/Division retain their separate roles.
groups.action: Require independently admitted Max generator capability. Empty initial targets are allowed. Actually obtain NONEMPTY output from a specifically enabled voice with accepted pitch/velocity before any population, range, origin or disabled-voice trial; Density or enable flags alone are insufficient. In Pattern tab operate per-voice rotation and Randomize; in Voices tab operate pitch/velocity and all-pitch arrows. On reset targets change Steps, Density and Division within explicit time-selection/loop contexts. Compare disable only after productive voice output and reset; do not infer pattern algorithm, wrapping formula, random law or MIDI delivery.
